name: Chosuke Nishimura
source:
Animal Type: Cat
Breed: Mixed
Hometown: Kariya, Aichi, Japan

Chiyomi's twin brother. Immigrated to Canada along with her, but chose to remain in Western Canada whilst severing all ties with his family. He thinks of them as clingy & burdensome, mostly from his childhood experiences. 

After many years in British Columbia, he regrets their separation and wishes to reunite. Unfortunately, his family is already quite fragmented with/over his presumed disappearance.
